newsitem.title: FRANCE: French 1997 public deficit/GDP ratio will be 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: French 1997 public deficit/GDP ratio will be 3 pct.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Wednesday that France's 1997 public deficits would be held to three percent of gross domestic product (GDP).
"I confirm that France will keep to its objective of limiting its deficits to three percent of GDP," Arthuis told a news conference.
Earlier, Arthuis said that France's 1996 deficit would be equal to 4.1 percent of GDP.
The French government had pledged to cut its budget deficit to four pct of GDP in 1996 from about five percent in 1995 but the overshoot did not worry him.
"It is a slippage of 0.1 percentage point and there is nothing in that to worry about. We kept our commitment," he added.
